text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing that Verxina looked tired,
I decided to have her rest in the infirmary."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Taking you up on your kind offer...
I think I will take the day off today.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Guh... It's even harsher than they say.
Uncharted territory... The world's highest 'Pinnacle'!

text_block_list.name: Party Members
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Verxina-san!
I just received a message!

text_block_list.name: Party Members
text_block_list.text:
The other squad led by Gentildonna-san
is also about to reach the summit!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Then all the more reason I cannot afford to stop now.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, everyone!
Be careful not to slip!

text_block_list.name: Venue Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"‘Everyone, thank you for attending the
“Verxina Summit Celebration Party”
despite the poor weather today...’"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Congrats, congrats~!!
A place so cold and high up...
To be the first in the world is super-duper amazing~!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
C-Congratulations, big sister.
I knew it... You really are our pride and joy.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Y-You both came to see me!!
And reaching the top of the world... H-How happy I am—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? It feels like I was just having a very happy dream.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You're feeling better now,
so it looks like you can get back to training!
